job.description:

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive training provided
  • An opportunity to work in a creative, supportive team environment

Ideal Candidate: We invite applicants who possess the following skills and attributes:

  • A reliable car and a valid Australian driver’s license are essential
  • Retail, supermarket, or merchandising experience is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Exceptional customer service skills and strong communication abilities
  • A well-presented professional with a flair for creativity
  • Reliable, physically fit, and comfortable working independently

How to Apply: Interested candidates will be contacted via email and phone for screening and interviews. Please ensure your resume is updated with your current contact information.

Join us and make every shopping experience a little more beautiful!
